tour.welcome.title: Welcome to Vairo
tour.welcome.body: Vairo takes you from an idea to your first customers — stage by stage. In a minute we'll show you where everything is.
tour.stage.title: Startup stage
tour.stage.body: This is where you work on your idea. You see one task at a time: answer, save, and the next one opens by itself. If you don't know an answer, you can skip the question and come back to it later.
tour.team.title: Team
tour.team.body: Startups are built by a few people. Invite friends with a link — they don't need a Vairo account yet.
tour.work.title: Team work
tour.work.body: Your team's documents and files in one place. As you move further in the program, goals and tasks will appear here.
tour.social.title: Social
tour.social.body: “Find a project” and “Find people” are cards you browse one by one. You can use a nickname on your card — only your team sees the name from your account.
tour.help.title: Help & feedback
tour.help.body: Something not working, something unclear, or have an idea? “Help & feedback” is always at the bottom of the menu. Write in your own words and the Vairo team replies by email.
